english.note: This is the all-purpose word for a person who ranks below you at work or in an organization.

examples.english: I’ll discuss it with my subordinate first, then report to the manager.
examples.traditional: 我會先同下屬傾清楚，再向經理報告。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 wui6 sin1 tung4 haa6 suk6 king1 cing1 co2 zoi3 hoeng3 ging1 lei5 bou3 gou3
